content.text:
The robot reached the green panel at the end of the corridor and is now resting, so the task is done.

The corridor wasn't straight. It ran about 4 m forward, then turned left at the end wall. The panel was on the far wall of that left branch. I walked to within roughly 10 cm of it, and the top camera showed the panel filling the view. The final approach was in small steps because the forward-blocking sensor kept tripping near the corner, so the final distance is estimated from the camera, not measured.

Robot is crouched with motors off, at about 99% battery.
